browser.detail: Cost and advance-approval distinction, access, eligibility limits, media attribution, provider-source link and interpreted connection inspected.

limits: Published in the context of workplace assault and work-accident consequences; ordinary team debriefing, general occupational stress and all difficult incidents are not established within this offering.

BGW says telephone counselling is possible; individual eligibility, actual admission, appointment waits and current capacity are unverified. No automatic entitlement or 24-hour emergency response asserted.

Separate therapy requires advance clarification of cost coverage and individual arrangements with the responsible BGW district administration. The FAQ does not explicitly establish this as a telephone-session admission rule.
No independent effectiveness or uptake evidence reviewed. Many people experience traumatic events without developing a disorder; the source does not justify assuming every incident causes illness.
No human status change; no public UI deployment or image generation; identity media internal only.

Full provider logo attributed on Wikimedia Commons and visually compared to official current branding, internal identity display only. No photograph of the actual counselling service approved; reuse rights unconfirmed.
Goal still active: remaining graph validation, solution depth, quantification and relevant media are incomplete.
